spanalyzer_comparison.interpretation: The array overload agrees with managed. The one-, two-, and three-scalar overloads produce false positives during row-type analysis. Rejecting mixed tokenizer kinds is a separate semantic question.
spanalyzer_comparison.google_reference: Its pre-existing synopsis shows a variable number of values. Its example passes one array. All three managed scalar diagnostics advertise TOKENLIST_CONCAT(ARRAY<TOKENLIST>).
spanalyzer_comparison.postgresql_reference: The November 13 correction describes concatenation instead of token debugging. The argument was already documented as spanner.tokenlist[] and the return as spanner.tokenlist. PostgreSQL runtime was not sampled.

schema_followup.table_options: Test explicit table options for non-default locality, columnar policy, custom dictionaries and role-specific visibility. Documented behavior omits default locality even if set explicitly. The published query returned zero rows against this empty schema.
schema_followup.column_and_locality_options: Compare explicit and inherited locality_group values. GoogleSQL documents BOOL and PostgreSQL documents character varying YES/NO; unrelated options have a NULL inheritance flag. For LOCALITY_GROUP_OPTIONS compare explicit and inherited storage with the NULL flag on ssd_to_hdd_spill_timespan. Only the GoogleSQL default group was sampled in the preceding receipt.
schema_followup.example: Both references describe a query as returning columns with non-default options, but the query filters only catalog or schema. A September 16 managed GoogleSQL sample documented 1,651 inherited default column rows across 206 tables.
schema_followup.index_options: Check explicit search options and system_optimized_tree_depth, system_optimized_num_leaves, system_optimized_num_branches for vectors. Compare INDEX_OPTIONS.index_type (documented VECTOR vs ScaNN) separately from INDEXES.index_type. Collect GetDatabaseDdl on the same populated schema in each dialect.

local_vector_projection.input_ddl: CREATE VECTOR INDEX VecIdx ON Items(Embedding) WHERE Embedding IS NOT NULL OPTIONS (distance_type = 'COSINE')
local_vector_projection.reproduction: Parse the DDL with memefish. Pass it to astconv.FromDDLStatements. Append three synthetic infoschem.IndexOption rows using TableName Items, IndexName VecIdx, IndexType VECTOR, OptionType INT64, OptionValue 2 and the three system_optimized option names above. Render with ToDDLStatements.
local_vector_projection.result: The reconstructed CREATE VECTOR INDEX contained all three system_optimized options with value 2, alongside distance_type. The documented GoogleSQL input options omit these system_optimized names.
local_vector_projection.scope: Synthetic local projection only. No live index metadata or managed DDL replay was tested.

schema_followup.postgresql_headings: placement_options and locality_group_options are corrected headings for existing sections. The changes do not establish new views.
